# Vendored Three.js

Three.js **0.160.1**, `package/build/three.module.min.js` from the published npm
tarball, preserved as `three.module.js`. MIT license is included alongside it.

SHA-256: `3e690ac7d180b0aadf0891bea39eec643e29e2d3e75c99b18689518665f69ba6`.

This 655 KiB self-contained module is served locally and loaded only after
explicitly entering experimental Halo World. No bundler, CDN import or runtime
node_modules path is used. Desktop does not import it. No automatic dependency
updates; upgrades require explicit review and World regression verification.
